One continuous shot with no cuts, no flashes, no dissolves and no added effects. Start exactly on the first photo and end exactly on the second photo. The same little boy is in both photos, and this clip shows him growing older right before our eyes, full of energy. Right away he jumps up and down, clapping and laughing, with big, joyful, real movement at a believable speed for his age. The camera is alive too: it pushes in toward his face at the start, then pulls back smoothly while he grows. During that pull-back, while he keeps moving, he visibly and smoothly grows older into the boy in the second photo: his face matures, his hair turns into the second photo's hair, his clothes turn into the second photo's clothes, and the place around him turns into the second photo's place. The motion never stops at the change. His face stays one solid, sharp face the whole time: never doubled, never see-through, never smeared. In each photo he looks exactly as in that photo (face, eyes, hairline); never add hair, makeup or accessories and never change his gender. He eases into the second photo's pose and framing over the last half second, so the last frame is the second photo. No people or text that are not in the photos.
